leadText:
A Misunderstanding (Japanese: VS コバルオン・テラキオン・ビリジオン II VS Cobalion, Terrakion, Virizion II), titled VS Cobalion / Terrakion / Virizion II in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 507th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 47th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Cobalion, Terrakion, Virizion II (Japanese: 信用 Trust) in the VIZ Media translation and A Misunderstanding in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
